text.brief: A wastewater analyst in Seattle flags an unfamiliar respiratory virus in samples from an airport in February 2031. The mainland's health authority has reported nothing. A doctor in Chengdu deleted a post that morning.
text.record: The United States left the World Health Organization on January 22, 2026. The Party delayed its reports on COVID-19 in December 2019 and January 2020, as the book's COVID chapter documents. The WHO declared eight public health emergencies of international concern from 2009 through 2024.
text.reading: The Party buys time at the start of an outbreak. It denies human transmission, silences doctors and praises its own openness, then sells masks and vaccines to a world it left unwarned. This is Stratagem 1, deceive the heavens to cross the sea.
text.coreEvent: The WHO declares a public health emergency for a novel respiratory pathogen first detected on the mainland before 2035.
text.gapText: Data Architecture. Early warning depends on the honesty of the government where the outbreak starts.
text.fix: Build warning that works without the Party's cooperation.
